description:
Host Evan Ross Katz joins Lisa Kudrow and Michael Patrick King to unpack Valerie’s final chapter, as she faces the future of Hollywood, challenges AI, and ultimately reclaims her voice. Later in the episode, Dan Bucatinsky joins the podcast to reflect on Billy’s evolution, his breakout “Star Billy” moment, and what it means for both him and Valerie to finally go their separate ways.

Stream Season 3 of #TheComeback on HBO Max.
